name: Mairusu-Love-Tale
source: In a world where content is generated very quickly, we've decided to train a MairusuBot to generate content on its own. You get 30 Days to build up love for MairusuBot and get to 100% to make it the perfect clone! You'll have to talk to him, answer his questions, and build up love!
translation: 在内容生成速度非常快的世界中，我们决定训练MairusuBot自行生成内容。你有30天的时间来培养对MairusuBot的喜爱，并达到100% 使其成为完美克隆！你必须和他交谈，回答他的问题，并建立爱！
